# Hunker

> Hunker is a comprehensive home and garden resource providing DIY inspiration, interior design tips, home improvement guides, and practical lifestyle advice for homeowners.

Hunker covers a wide range of home-related topics including interior design, home improvement projects, gardening, real estate, home security, and budget-friendly DIY solutions. The site features expert contributors and actionable guides for homeowners at all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Home Improvement
- Interior Design
- DIY Projects
- Gardening & Yard Maintenance
- Home Organization
- Home Security
- Budget-Friendly Tips
- Cleaning Hacks
- Real Estate & Home Staging
- Furniture & Decor
- Kitchen & Bathroom Remodeling
- HVAC & Appliances
- Landscaping
- Home Design Trends

## Home Improvement & Renovation

- [Home Improvement - Hunker](https://www.hunker.com/home-building?page=5): Home repair, remodeling guides for kitchens, bathrooms, appliances, and HVAC.

## Home Design & Interior Decor

- [Design - Hunker](https://www.hunker.com/home-design?page=3): Home design tips, DIY projects, interior decor, and furniture refresh guides.

## Real Estate & Home Staging

- [Real Estate - Hunker](https://www.hunker.com/houses?page=11): Real estate advice on market trends, home staging, selling, and resale value.

## Home Security & Safety

- [Home Security - Hunker](https://www.hunker.com/home-safes?page=3): Home security gadgets, door locks, break-in prevention, and safety tips.
